about_the_game:
Shoplifter: No Escape is an interactive erotic detective game that blends narrative choice, puzzle-mini-games, and adult scenes.

You are Derrick Wolfe, the lone night guard in a quiet supermarket. When provocateur and social-media artist Vanessa Bloom is caught stealing designer headphones, you get to extract the truth and only one outcome awaits.

FEATURES:

  • Match Photo Puzzle: Rearrange scrambled tiles to restore a surveillance snapshot. Only perfect completion unlocks your next move.
  • Take Photo: Three official shots. Three risque poses captured for “evidence.”
  • Intimate Reward: With no mercy option, your sole choice after the puzzle is an adult scene with Vanessa, designed to reward your detective work.
  • TimeKiller Mini-Game: While evidence is processed, play a fast-paced tile-clearing challenge against the clock, uncovering sensual 2D artwork.

content_descriptors.notes:
Shoplifter: No Escape contains explicit sexual content and full nudity. The game features a consensual erotic interrogation scene with graphic adult animation, as well as suggestive 2D images revealed in a mini-game. There is no depiction of non-consensual sex, underage content, or sexual violence.

All adult content is intended strictly for mature audiences (18+).
